summary_en: 650,000 shares (3.51% S/O), ¥1,000M upper limit, open-market buy via TSE, Aug 17–Dec 30, 2026. All acquired shares to be cancelled within the quarter of completion.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On 14 August 2026, KEIWA Incorporated's board of directors authorized the acquisition and subsequent cancellation of treasury shares. The company will acquire up to 650,000 shares (3.51% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 17 August and 30 December 2026, with a total acquisition budget not to exceed ¥1,000 million. The board cited valuation levels and current share price as rationale for executing opportunistic buybacks to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency. All acquired shares are mandated for cancellation in the quarter in which acquisition completes; the cancellation date will be announced once the purchase period concludes. As of 30 June 2026, the company held 778,002 treasury shares against 18,507,150 shares outstanding (excluding treasury).
